sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:14

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 9:14:1
items.html: The very body of Malchut is made of the Gevurot called BON, which were extended through the posterior of ZA; but her actual Nefesh, etc., at the time of the first coupling: Meaning, the Katnut of Malchut, which is the essence of her building, as is known, is made from the lights of BON that were extended to her through the aperture behind the chest of ZA, as explained in its place. But her actual Nefesh — namely, the Gadlut within her, that she may be fit to bear souls, that is, the discernment of the vessel that raises the MAN, and the Ruach within the vessel, as above — this is given to her at the first intercourse, as explained above.
